identity.name: Heritage Autavia
identity.one_liner: TAG Heuer's 2017 reissue of the 1962 Autavia, its dial chosen by public vote and nicknamed for F1 driver Jochen Rindt, since discontinued.

narrative.story: Heuer introduced the Autavia in 1962 as a dashboard and wrist chronograph aimed at both racing drivers and pilots — the name blends AUTomobile and AVIAtion. For its 2017 Heritage re-edition, TAG Heuer ran a public online vote across sixteen vintage Autavia references in 2016; the winning dial, resembling the watch worn by 1970 Formula 1 champion Jochen Rindt, became reference CBE2110, powered by the automatic Heuer 02 movement.
narrative.collector_notes: Sold on leather strap (CBE2110.FC8226) or steel bracelet (CBE2110.BA0687) under the same base reference; both configurations are now listed as discontinued on TAG Heuer's own site.
